question: Which of the following is the most important festival celebrated by the Muslim community in India to mark the beginning of the Islamic New Year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Muharram**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Muharram** is the most important festival celebrated by the** Muslim community in India to mark the beginning of the Islamic New Year.**
 
• Muharram is celebrated as the advent of the Islamic New Year by participating Muslims around the globe.
 
• It is regarded as a pious and important festival by the community. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Eid al-Fitr **marks the end of Ramzan, the Muslim holy month of fasting, and is celebrated during the first three days of Shawwal, the 10th month of the Islamic calendar
 
• **Shab-e-Miraj or The Night of Ascent** is one of the most celebrated dates of the Islamic calendar.
 
• **Id-ul-Zuha (Bakr-Id),** is a festival of great rejoice, special prayers, and exchange of greetings and gifts mark this festival of Muslims.
 
 
• Id-ul-Zuha, the festival of sacrifice is celebrated with traditional fervor and gaiety in India and the world.
 
 
 
• **Milad-un-nabi festival** is celebrated to mark the birth anniversary of Prophet Muhammad.
 
 
• This day is celebrated in the month of Rabi’ al-awwal (Third month of the Islamic calendar).
